name: 今日大切にしたい習慣一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0011「今日大切にしたい習慣一覧」, ONE Japanese seven-item daily-habit list.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Finch screen controls emoji/artwork geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, recurrence glyphs and missing metadata. Use ONLY heading/date and FIRST SEVEN habits (through three deep breaths); later snack/shower/footer belong outside this component. Image2 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for exact Japanese names and locked type; it omits recurring-arrow icons and9:00AM times on first/last rows. Restore them from original. Images3–4 original glass/leaf artwork crops, preserve geometry/colors. Image5 approved Lighthouse bus STYLE ONLY for white surface, neutral outline and soft downward shadow.
Design: one compact tall white rounded card on pure white canvas, logical390x500 proportion. Upper-left metadata「8月27日・今日」, title「今日は何を大切にしたい？」. Seven vertically aligned rows, each original colored emoji artwork on left, bold Japanese habit title beside it, smaller recurrence metadata below title. No individual nested cards, checkboxes, action buttons, extra tasks or page chrome. Full list visible with no clipping.
Exact rows and original artwork:
1「水を飲む」— original glass of water with red/white striped straw; metadata「午前9:00・」then original two-arrow recurrence glyph and「毎日」.
2「ベッドから起きる」— original sunflower; recurrence glyph「毎日」.
3「顔を洗う」— original pink soap with bubbles; recurrence glyph「毎日」.
4「歯を磨く」— original teal toothbrush angled down-right; recurrence glyph「毎日」.
5「背伸びする」— original small yellow giraffe; recurrence glyph「毎日」.
6「うれしいことを一つ」— original yellow closed-smiling-eyes rosy-cheek face; recurrence glyph「毎日」.
7「深呼吸を三回」— original green leaf with three blue wind strokes; metadata「午前9:00・」then recurrence glyph「毎日」.
Artwork exactness: preserve original shapes/proportions/colors, no generic icon substitutions. Utility recurrence glyphs follow ORIGINAL opposing curved arrows shape and optical weight, normalized to coherent slate#526173. Do not omit them or replace with an arbitrary refresh symbol.
Typography locked: Meiryo Bold20/28 title, Bold14/24 habit names, Regular12/16 date and recurrence metadata, tracking0. Main ink#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E. Keep Japanese names in black; original purple keyword highlights are decorative emphasis, not states/groups, so omit those colors while preserving name weight. Original emoji colors are protected artwork and remain.
White card with subtle neutral border, restrained soft downward shadow, quiet24px corners, orderly compact row spacing, aligned baselines and readable text. No mint panels, random colored utility icons, gradient page, glow/gloss, metrics, extra copy or device frame. Raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画/7図像クロップ/日本語モックを実見。原画主参照で欠落した反復矢印7個と水/深呼吸の午前9:00を回復、元の図像色は保持し紫の装飾文字色は省いた。結果実見:7項目/日本語/時刻/反復/白面/見切れなしを確認。ただしキリンの姿勢と輪郭が原画クロップから再描画で変わったため、その図像に限定修正が必要。厳密な書体/原画ピクセルは未証明。所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
